content.title: What Analysts Think Is Changing The Albemarle Story After Recent Lithium Market Shifts
content.summary: Albemarle’s fair value estimate has inched up to about $107 per share from roughly $103, as analysts factor in firmer medium term lithium pricing and improved earnings power. This comes alongside a slightly lower discount rate of around 7.81% versus about 7.83% and a marginally more conservative revenue growth outlook of roughly 10.46% compared with approximately 10.52%, reflecting a more balanced yet still constructive narrative.
